Commentary.Commentary: Just what India needed and planned. Took them just 10 balls to wrap up the last wicket. England could only manage to add 2 runs to their overnight score. This is their fifth lowest score against India batting first at home. They didn't get to the psychological 300-run mark but now have work to do with the ball. India's first aim will be to bat well and see off the new ball. They will start their reply in a few minutes. Don't go anywhere.

OUT! Inswing, inswing and then an outswing which produces the edge. No fifer for Ashwin. But a good overall bowling performance from India. Shami serves this outside off, it moves away, Curran flirts with it and gets an edge which Karthik doesn't drop. ENGLAND ARE ALL OUT FOR 287.
Angles this into Curran who moves away and gets hit on his thigh pad.
Back of a length ball on off, Curran defends it down.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Curran.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Short ball down the leg side, Anderson blocks it with a straight bat.
Jimmy has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Ohh!!! Almost! Ashwin fires this one around off, the ball drifts in sharply and Anderson gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Will pick up a brace for it.
On middle and leg, played to short mid-wicket.
Another loopy ball around off, Anderson taps it in front of him.
Slower one on middle and leg, Anderson blocks it out well. The crowd cheers him.

Ready to begin. As James Anderson and Sam Curran walk out to bat basking in the warm sunshine, India will be wanting to clean them up in the first few overs itself and have a go with the bat. Anderson to take strike, with Ravichandran Ashwin being handed the ball to him.

Sanjay Manjrekar first says that there is a cool wind blowing across the ground but it will only get warmer. About the pitch, he says that it will become difficult for the left-handers to play as there is a rough developed around the off stump. Reckons that India will miss the services of Jadeja and Kuldeep. He adds saying that the pitch has not changed much  and it is not a wicket-taking surface. Continues saying that the batsmen will get out cheaply if they do. Ends saying that these are good signs for India.

Taking this last wicket for India will be like killing that 0.1 percent of the germs that your antiseptics don't kill. They have done the hard work and now need to wrap things up as soon as possible. Day 1 was everything a Test match needed. There were wickets, runs and some moments of madness. Root, Bairstow and Jennings did their best with the bat but threw their wickets away. Ashwin and Shami were India's best bowlers. Anderson and Curran now have the opportunity to frustrate the opposition. For the hosts, Sam Curran may look to take the attack to the Indians while James Anderson will need to keep him accompanied. Will Ashwin get a fifer? Or will one of the pacers clean them up? Remains to be seen. For the doubters, all who want to see how the Indian batsmen fare, let's see how long they are made to wait. The weather seems fine and all those who have paid the big bucks will pray it stays that way. Action from Day 2 is not far away.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Had Karthik caught Anderson off the second last ball of the day, India's day would be sweeter. For now, England will come out to bat on Day 2. The tourists will hope to get them out as quickly as possible and get past the total in front of them. Day 2 is set for another cracking contest. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Join in at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Cheers!

England were not bad with the bat but gave up their wickets cheaply. Cook fell to a beauty while the rest fell prey to the visitors. Jennings and Root stitched 72 for the second wicket but two quick breakthroughs post lunch got them on the back foot. Skipper Root and Bairstow then added 104 for the fourth wicket and were taking the game away from the touring side. But the turning point was Root's run out where skipper Kohli's athleticism got him his counterpart. It was all India then as they didn't allow the tail to wag.

Ashwin was given the ball early in the day and he did just what his captain asked him to do. Picked up the big fish, Cook, and got Buttler and Stokes in quick time later on. Shami too was substantial with the ball and got a brace for his efforts. Ishant was making the ball move and Yadav who came back strongly after a poor start got a wicket each.
Lovely day of Test cricket. After all of it I think it is safe to say that the day belonged to the Indians. They picked wickets at important phases that pegged the hosts back.
England will come out to bat tomorrow. Anderson drives this fuller ball to covers. ENGLAND ARE 285/9 AT THE END OF DAY 1.

DROPPED! Oh dear! The catching has not been the best and India had a chance to finish the job today itself. On a good length outside off, Anderson gets an outside edge behind. Karthik flies to his left but the ball doesn't stick. Had he left it, it would have been a dolly for Dhawan at first slip.
Full on that fifth stump line, cut to third man for a single. Anderson to face the final two balls.
Outside off, Curran thinks of playing at it but pulls out at the last minute.
Fuller on middle and off, Curran blocks it back to the bowler.
Stays back and punches the ball to covers.
Works this down the leg side to retain strike for the next over.
Stays in his crease and sees this one off.
Curran has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Drives this through covers and some good work by Dhawan in the deep keeps it to two.
Tossed up ball on middle and off, Curran hits it onto the ground.
Finally James gets bat to ball and survives another over. Fuller this time on off, well blocked by Anderson.
Three in a row. Anderson will be thanking his heavens he is not getting a feather to it. Another play and miss from him. The crowds are in loud voice.
Lovely from Sharma. Making Anderson play at it. Another length ball around off, Anderson is caught on his back foot and misses the ball.
Serves this on a good length outside off, Anderson flirts with it and almost gets an outside edge.
Length down the leg side, Anderson shuffles across and leaves it alone.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Curran tucks it away to the corner to give Anderson the strike.
Anderson survives. Leans forward and blocks this in front of him.
This one too comes back in. But Anderson stays back and does well to get bat to it.
Gives this one air outside off, Anderson leaves it alone.
Slower ball on middle, Anderson blocks.
James Anderson is the last man in.

OUT! Brilliant from Ashwin! This one comes back in and that is what does Broad in. Tosses this one up around off and it spins back in. Broad plays for the spin and gets hit on his pads. An easy decision for Aleem Dar and Broad walks back. The end is nigh for England.
Slow ball spins away from Broad who leaves it alone.
Slow full toss, hit to mid on for one.
Peach! Squares Broad up who hangs his bat outside off.
FOUR BYES! Banged in short down the leg side, Broad looks to tuck it away but cannot get anything on it. DK dives full stretch to his right but the ball races past him to the fine leg fence.
Full outside off, Broad swings and misses.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Stuart Broad walks out next to bat.

OUT! Plumb! It is not going down leg and Ishant Sharma provides the breakthrough. Lands this on a good length and it comes back into Rashid. Perhaps done by the pace and the ball strikes him on his pad. The Indians appeal but the umpire stays put. Sharma looks confident and asks Kohli to take it up. Replays roll in and show us three reds. A stubborn partnership is finally broken. Will India get them all out today?
An LBW review is taken up. Ishant is confident! Is it going down leg?
Darts this on middle and leg, Curran hits it back towards the bowler. The question on many Indians' minds is that when will India take the new ball!
Turns his bat and tucks it around the corner.
Loopy ball down leg, hit to short mid-wicket.
Gives this air on middle and leg, Sam is solid in his defense.
Slower one around off, Sam blocks it with a straight bat.
Quicker one on off, hit to mid on.
Curran flicks it away with a wristy shot to square leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Beauty! Almost squares him up. After three bouncers he serves one on a good length around off. With no feet movement Sam pokes at it and almost edges it.
Three in a row. This one too is banged hard down the leg side. Sam evades it well.
Another one of those. Trying to scare Sam is Sharma who once again ducks under it.
Bangs this one short on middle and leg, Curran ducks under it.
Hops a touch and tucks it around the corner for one. A handy partnership this for the hosts. 34 from 42 balls.
Turns his bat to the on side to the fielder.
Stays low and blocks it down.
Goes back and flicks it away to backward square leg to rotate strike.
Gets behind the ball and taps it in front of him.
Short down leg, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Sam defends it from within the crease.
Stays inside and cuts it to third man for a single.
Wide outside off stump, Curran leaves it alone.

FOUR! Excellent! All timing on that! That's a shot any batsman would be proud of. Stays back and punches it in the gap through the covers for a boundary. Holds his pose for the camera men to do their work.
Pitches this one up outside off, driven to covers.
Gets behind the ball and defends it off his back foot.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Curran.
Dabs this towards backward point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Leans forward and blocks it well.
FOUR! He is no rookie with the bat. Charges down to this loopy ball and flicks it aerially over square leg for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! An outswinger from Ashwin. Gets the ball to move the other way and Rashid picks it up well. Guides it late past the first slip fielder to the third man fence.
Rashid rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
FOUR! Shot! Curran is full of confidence. Sees the loose ball outside off and cuts this in the gap through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, cut to backward point.
On a good length outside off, Curran shoulders his arms to it.
Punched off the back foot by Curran towards cover-point.
Full and wide again, once again Curran goes after it but this time cannot get the desired result.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Curran leans forward and drives it handsomely through covers for a boundary.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.
Sam has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flicked away through mid-wicket for a double.
Outside off, SC leaves it alone.
Sharp turn from Ash. Lands it around off and almost gets the outside edge of Curran.
Sam has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, left alone.
In the air but safe! Rashid flicks this full ball aerially and just about clears the mid-wicket fielder. A couple taken and that's the 250 up for England.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Short ball angling down, ducked and evaded.
From around the wicket, full and coming in, Curran gets an edge which keeps low and goes through the slip cordon. Two runs taken.
Full and angling in around off, Rashid gets it off the outer half through gully for a single.
Slower one outside off, Curran leaves it alone.
Byes. That misses everyone. Sneaks through bat and pad and past Karthik. They will take a bye.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets low and sees this one off.
Stays back and defends this with a straight bat.
Adil Rashid is the next man in.

OUT! A poor, poor shot from Stokes and it has lead to his downfall. A short ball on middle and leg from Ashwin, Stokes had a lot of time to play it anywhere, maybe too much time. He looks to turn it to the on side and gets a leading edge straight to Ashwin. He moves to his left and accepts it with glee. So many hopes were relying on him but he has failed yet again.
Edge but does not carry. Curran hangs his bat outside off and gets a feather on it, the ball just falls short of Dhawan at first slip.
Curran was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Slides this one on leg, Stokes flicks it away to the on side for a run.
Good line from Shami. Forces Stokes to play at it. Comes in from round the wicket and angles this into him. Stokes goes for the drive but the ball goes past his bat.
Ben shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good ball from Shami. Bangs this one short outside off. The ball takes off and Stokes sways away from it.
Darts this one quick on off, Curran gets an inside edge onto his pads.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Loopy ball around off, Curran gets low and blocks it.
Slower one in line of the stumps, Curran taps it in front of him.
Full on middle, played with a straight bat.
Gives this air, on middle and leg, tucked away to the on side.
Hangs back and flicks this to the same region.
Full this time on middle and off, worked to mid-wicket.
Ben lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good time this for Stokes to counter-attack. Flicks this ball through mid-wicket for a brace.
Not quick enough to put Stokes on his back foot who covers his stumps and blocks it out.
Stays in his crease and plays it to short mid-wicket.
Full in line of the stumps, well blocked by Curran.
Lunges back and flicks it away to square leg for a single.
Charges down the pitch to this loopy ball and hits it to mid on.
Stays inside and tucks the ball to the on side.
Times this nicely through square leg and has enough time to come back for the second.
Floated on middle, Stokes prods forward in defense.

Drinks are on the field. India have made their way back into this game well in this final session. The big wickets of Bairstow and Root, along with that of the big-hitting Jos Buttler has certainly lifted their spirits. Now, Ben Stokes is the last batsman who remains. Can the Indians get rid of him quick and wrap the Englishmen today itself?
Full outside off, driven through the gap in the covers this time. It won't go all the way as Murali Vijay chases it down, but it's enough to fetch Stokes three good runs.
FOUR! Very full and quite straight, Stokes without any trouble flicks it away through mid-wicket and says thank you as he finds the boundary easily.
Darts it fuller, just outside off, pushed away gently on the off side.
Is right behind the line as he punches it to short mid-wicket.
Some shape away from the batsman. Stokes takes a big step out of the crease to negate the movement but still gets beaten past the outside edge.
Back of a length angling in on middle and off, Stokes moves inside the line and works it away on the leg side.
Mohammed Shami to bowl again.
Flights it up well as he bowls it outside off, Curran drives it straight to the cover fielder.
Full and wide outside off, smacked hard straight to covers.
Quicker and flatter outside off, dabbed with an open face square to point.
On middle and turning away from the left-hander, Curran shapes up for the shot and defends it on the off side.
Quicker through the air, outside off, forced away square on the off side.
Drifting in on a full length, around off, Curran prods forward and blocks it out.
Immense swing inwards as Umesh pitches this full, Sam Curran clips it in front of square leg and takes one.
Full and wide, Stokes walks a couple of steps across and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Short of a good length outside off, punched hard off the back foot to extra cover.
Full in length, on middle and off, flicked right at the man at mid-wicket.
Holding its line as it lands on a length outside off, Stokes covers the line and watches as the ball goes past him.
FOUR! Beautifully played by Ben Stokes. Umesh angles in a full delivery on middle and leg, flicked through square leg. The placement is good, it's past the square leg fielder to the boundary.
A bit quicker through the air, on middle and leg, Curran goes deep inside the crease and blocks it out.
Tossed up off break outside off, Curran plants his front foot forward and pushes it away.
Sam Curran will be the new man in.

OUT! Now Buttler is gone! This is plumb. India are well and truly back into the this game. Ashwin loops it up around off, it's quite slow through the air as it turns back in and catches Buttler on the knee roll who looks to work it across the line. Big appeal, the finger goes up and Jos doesn't even bother with the review. He know what the outcome's going to be.
Flighted around off, kept out by coming forward.
Yorker darted in on the stumps, it's dug out towards mid-wicket. Quick run stolen.
Tossed up outside off, driven hard but straight to cover.
Jos Buttler is the new man in.

OUT! He's dragged it on! Oh, that's a big wicket. He was just taking the game away from the Indians but Umesh Yadav just comes up with a rabbit out of the hat. This is a huge wicket. Back of a length, too close for Bairstow to cut and he's done in. Gets an inside edge back onto the stumps and the fielding side is ecstatic.
Superb running. Good, early call from Stokes as he taps this down in front of him and crosses over.
Loose from Stokes. The full length, wide outside off, tempted him and he almost got undone because of it. Looks to smash it through the covers but gets beaten.
Short of a length, played back to the bowler.
Good length ball, outside off, Big Ben doesn't bother himself with it.

Good save from Virat Kohli. Saved a certain boundary there. Full and swinging away outside off, Bairstow drives it towards covers, where Kohli dives to his left and makes a half-stop. Just a single results.
Flatter and shorter in line of the stumps, Stokes is on the back foot as he turns it to mid-wicket.
Leans ahead, gets close to the pitch and blocks it out safely.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Leans ahead to this tossed up delivery and drives it just wide of mid on for one more.
Picks it off his pads and works it away on the leg side for a single.
Lands it short and quick on the pads, worked behind square leg for an easy single.
On a good length and outside off, arms are shouldered by Ben Stokes.
Holds the pose as he drives this full ball to mid off.
Brings it in closer to the off pole, Stokes moves a step across and blocks it down right under his nose.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander, length ball outside off, Stokes has no trouble letting it be.
Just wide of the man at mid on this time. One run to the total.
Low full toss on middle and off, the attempted yorker which slightly misses, Jonny drives it off the bottom half to mid on.
Umesh Yadav is back.
Flicked with a closed face through mid-wicket. Single to end a much, much-needed successful over from Ravichandran Ashwin.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
Looped up on off, blocked out off the front foot.
Ben Stokes walks out next to bat.

OUT! JOE ROOT IS RUN OUT! A wicket against the run of play and it's all because of the athleticism of the Indian skipper Virat Kohli. Bairstow works this through mid-wicket and both batsmen set off quickly. They want the second, rush for it but Kohli is quick to the ball. He picks it up, turns and fires it at the bowler's end and actually scores a direct hit from a long distance. Unreal. Credit to Ashwin too, he knows where the ball's headed so doesn't touch it at all. Even the dive doesn't save Root, he's gone. Just what India wanted. Can they capitalize on this now?

FOUR! The 100-run stand is up. These two are powering England away to a commanding position. Floated across outside off, Bairstow gets bat on ball and gets a thick edge. It goes down to third man and a boundary results.
Starts off from around the wicket and drifts it across, Bairstow is forward to block it out.
Ravichandran Ashwin is back on to have a go. Will he be the one to break this partnership?
Back of a length on off, cramping the batsman for room, it's worked just wide of mid-wicket again. One more run to end the over. A productive one for England, 12 from it.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Shortens the length again, too straight in line this time, Bairstow wrists it just wide of the man at mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for him. Teaser outside off, well away from his body but Bairstow has good hands. Sees the ball well and hits it through cover-point for another boundary.
FOUR! Too full, too straight, too easy for Jonny Bairstow. He comfortably drives it past mid on and finds the boundary line. 18th Test fifty for Jonny Bairstow. Splendid knock so far.
Loves that area, doesn't he? Shaping away from around off, Root shapes himself up for the shot as he opens the face and runs it down to third man for one.
Cuts it late just past the second slip fielder for a single.

Inside edge has saved him! That's the only thing that could have saved him and yes... that's it! Replays confirm it too. Good call from Kohli and co. not to opt for the review. Root will consider himself lucky there, would be a dead duck if not for the willow. Full and straight from Shami, Root goes for the drive but misses and wears it on the pads, but not before the ball takes the inside edge.
Just a little tap. Bairstow places it just wide of backward point and it's enough to earn him a run.
Fullish on off, Jonny mistimes the drive back to the bowler.
Opens the face of the bat to this fuller delivery and drives it a bit square through the off side. A brace is collected.
Length delivery, on middle and leg without any movement on it. Bairstow looks to flick it away but wears it on the pads.
Fraction straight in line, on a length, clipped away in front of square leg. One run to end the over.
Full ball attacking the foundation of the off stump, swinging away, driven straight to mid off.
Since it's coming in, Root uses the angle well but getting inside the line and turns it to square leg for one.
Short of a length, angling in this time and cramping Root for some room. But he still manages to force it away towards the covers.
Moving away shortly again, on off, a defensive push from Joe on the off side.
Fuller length delivery with a hint of shape away from the batsman, outside off, Root leaves it alone, as he should. No need to play at those.
Jonny Bairstow defends this one from within the crease.
FOUR! Short of a length outside off, some width on offer which Bairstow uses to his full advantage. Flays it over point and finds the fence.
Dabs this behind point and gets off strike.
Pushes this towards mid on and takes off. The fielder there comes charging in to the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end, but Jonny Bairstow is well in by then.
A bit of a slash from Bairstow. Just misses. Looks to flay the length ball outsider off but fails to connect.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Back of a length on middle, turned in front of square on the leg side. Easy run for the batsmen.
Just short! Bairstow drives this half-volley on the up towards a diving Virat Kohli at cover. Did as well as he could to get low forward, but it fell painfully short of his hands.
Angling in on a back of a length, then moving away late off the surface, Root camps back, dabs it into the off side and gets off strike.
Too wide outside off, slapped behind point, towards third man for a single.
Root rocks onto the back foot in a jiffy and drags the pull from outside off to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Hurls it outside off, on a length, left alone.

FOUR! Beautiful shot from Bairstow! That was a boundary the moment it left the bat. Full outside off, Jonny drives it right off the meat and finds the gap through the cover region. No stopping that one.
Tap and run stuff from Joe Root. This is good running between the wickets. Pushes this down in front of cover and both batsmen quickly complete the run.
Good length delivery outside off, shaping away from the batsman. Joe Root leaves it alone.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, flicked through the square leg area for an easy single.
Almost a half-volley, on off, driven to mid off.
Too far of off stump, left alone by the batsman.
FOUR! Poor end to the over from Hardik as he lets out consecutive boundaries. Short and down the leg side, Root just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.

FOUR! Too full and angling into the pads, Root is too good a player to not punish this. He leans across a touch and flicks it ever so well through mid-wicket. Even beats the man out in the deep. Superb timing.
Pitched outside the line of off stump, Joe covers the line and lets it go.
Bit short again, Root stands tall and pats it away with soft hands.
Short of a length into the body, nudged in front of square leg for a single.
Hardik starts off with a sharp bouncer. On middle, Jonny ducks and lets it sail over his head.
Hardik Pandya will bowl from the other end.
Inside edge again! Bairstow looks to block but gets it off the edge on the leg side, past the leg pole. Takes a quick run and beats the shy at the non-striker's end.
Extremely full on off, driven straight back to the bowler. Good technique from Bairstow. Planted that front foot well forward, kept the elbow high and presented the full face of the bat.
This one kicks off the surface after pitching on a length, Bairstow plays away from his body and edges it. On the bounce towards Rahane at third slip.
On the fuller side of the length, on off again, blocked out.
Fullish length delivery attacking the off stump, blocked by coming on the front foot.
An edgy FOUR! This one keeps a little low as it lands on a length around off, Bairstow hangs his bat out and gets an outside edge, which races past second slip. Boundary results.
We are back for the final session of the day. Joe Root and Jonny Bairstow will take their place in the center, while Mohammed Shami has the ball in his hand.
... Day 1, Session 3 ...

Safe to say this was England's session, despite India getting two wickets. Early in it, Shami struck twice to remove Jennings and Malan in quick succession. Seemed like the visitors would capitalize from that point on, but the pair of Root and Bairstow pulled things back confidently in England's favour with 51 runs between them. The wicket is misbehaving a bit, there's some uneven bounce on the surface. So, this final session will be crucial in determining which direction this match could go. Big one coming up for both teams. Don't go anywhere, it starts in a short while...
Fullish in length outside off, Bairstow punches it just wide of gully and takes a single. TEA ON DAY 1!
Stays back and punches it into the off side, won't get any run for it.
That's kept a little low. Bairstow will feel lucky that wasn't on the stumps. Well outside off, the tries to reach out for it but the ball goes under his bat.
Has some room outside off, cut down straight to short third man.
Brings out the short one and hits the deck hard, YJB ducks and evades.
Length ball skidding off the deck a bit, on off, Jonny Bairstow is well forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flicks it away again, with some decent power. Goes off Vijay and lobs behind. No run taken though.
Takes a big stride forward and makes sure to block it before the ball turns.
Plays with the spin and turns it away past short leg.
Comes from around the wicket, drifts it across around off, Joe goes back to block.
The 50-run stand comes up. Both have played well. Quite comfortably too, for the most part. Root plays this square through point and takes two.
Worked straight to short third man this time.

Edged and FOUR! Bairstow doing that for the second time since he's come on. Needs to be a tad more careful. Maybe Kohli needs to take third slip a little wider? Or reposition gully. Full and outside off, Bairstow drives away from his body and gets a thick edge which flies down and across the third man boundary.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, Root misses the flick as the ball goes off his thigh pads. A leg bye taken as it rolls to square leg.
Just a tame push from Root. A good extension of the arms as he drives the full length ball to mid off.
Keeps it on the fourth stump channel, Joe plays it back to the bowler.
On a length, aiming the top of off stump, Root is perfectly behind the line as he blocks it in front of cover.
Good, firm punch from Jonny Bairstow. Places it through the covers and comes back for the second.
Plays it to the leg side again after getting inside the line.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and work it past short leg.
Leans ahead and knocks the full ball to mid off.
Well adjusted by Bairstow. Walks across and down the track to play and when he sees Ashwin drag it short and flat, he does well to get into position and work it on the leg side.
Short of a length, on off, Root stands tall and taps it square on the off side. Wants the run but then decides against it.
Not much pace on this and Joe plays it with soft hands too. Well outside off, he looks to cut it but it goes off the edge to the diving first slip fielder on the bounce.
Full on off, angling in first then shaping away, Root pushes it in front of cover after getting squared up a bit.
Better. Leaves it alone this time. Outside off on a length, not enough to trouble the batsman.
A loose shot from Root. Not sure why he needs to do that. Length ball outside off, the English skipper flirts with it and almost nicks it behind.
Angles in a length ball from wide of the crease, close to off, Root keeps bat and pad close while defending it out.
Hardik Pandya is called back on.
Comes forward and smothers the ball in its tracks.
Full and loopy on the stumps, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Spinning down the leg side, Bairstow misses his flick and gets it off the pads. It goes towards the diving leg gully fielder.
Quicker through the air around off, Jonny Bairstow goes back and keeps it out down the track.
FOUR! A little too full from around the wicket and Ashwin is punished. On the stumps, Bairstow plants his front foot forward and lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on middle and off, wristed away down to mid on. Single taken.
Ravichandran Ashwin returns.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Bairstow hops a tad and bunts it down to the leg side.
On a good length, comes back in. Cut to short covers.
Good cricket from the England captain. Taps this with soft hands to the off side and sprints to the other end.
Another ball down leg, not the best of lines from Yadav. Root clips it away through mid-wicket this time for a couple of runs.
Length around off, Root has his arms shouldered to it.
FOUR! Angles this onto the pads of Root who uses his wrists and flicks it away to the vacant deep square leg region for a boundary. Easy pickings.
Full and coming back in, Jonny gets low and drives it to mid off.
Cuts it towards point to get one more.
Leg bye. Strays this on the leg side. Bairstow tries flicking it but cannot make contact with the bat. The ball rolls to the on side as they do well to rotate the strike.
Stays in his crease and plays it with soft hands to the off side.
Pushed to the cover region by Bairstow.
Comes in from over the wicket and lands it on a good length around off, Bairstow gets a bottom edge towards covers.
Stays within his crease and cuts this to third man to retain strike.
Full around off, driven to the mid off fielder.
Whips this in the gap through square leg for a brace.
'Waiiiittttttt onnnnn' shouts Bairstow as he bunts this down onto the ground.
Strays this down the leg side, Root easily works this to deep square leg for one.
Great yorker on middle and leg. Root gets his bat down just in time to dig it out.
Joe plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Short and wide outside off, Root is not in the best position to cut it and maybe that's why he didn't get any bat to it.
Controls his pull shot towards square leg to get to the other end.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Classic! Over corrects his length and pitches it too full outside off, Bairstow leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Short again outside off, cut to point.
Full on middle and leg, played towards mid-wicket.
Short and wide outside off, Root guides it towards gully.
Full this time around off, Root looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On the bounce to Karthik. Not the quickest ball from Yadav. Outside off, Root leaves it alone.
Full and straight in line of the stumps, hit back to the bowler.
Plays this late towards deep backward point and keeps the fielder busy. They come back for the second run.
Tucks this away through mid-wicket and will get two runs for it.

Fifty for Root! 41st Test fifty and 9th against India. He is carrying on his form from the limited-overs leg and is looking in fine rhythm. Works this to deep square leg for a single to get to his landmark.
Angles this into Bairstow who helps it on its way. They think of the second but is rightly sent back.
Covers his stumps and blocks it out.
Pitches this one up in line of the stumps, Bairstow drives it to mid off.
Waits for it and tucks it square of the wicket on the leg side for one.
Ishant Sharma comes back for another spell.
Another good yorker. Full and straight on middle, Root turns his bat to the leg side to change ends.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the skipper.
Fires in a yorker on middle, Root is late but does well to get bat on that.
Jonny guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Full and on middle, hit to mid on.
How did that miss? Pitches this one around off and moves away with some venom. Bairstow goes for the drive and almost gets an outside edge to it.
Tossed up down the leg side, Root gets hit on the pad trying to flick the ball. The players appeal but it eventually dies down.
FOUR! Full toss and nicely timed through covers. Ashwin misses his length and gives Root a low full toss. Joe gets forward and drives it neatly through extra cover for a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Turns his bat to the leg side for nothing.
Rocks back and punches this in the gap through covers. The ball doesn't go all the way but they come back for the third.
Shorter and flatter outside off, Bairstow goes back and keeps it out.
Full and swinging away outside off, Root drives it to the cover fielder.
Bairstow is off the mark. Gets a full ball on his pads so he flicks it away to fine leg for a single.
Fraction straight in line, worked to mid-wicket.
Jonny Bairstow is the next batsman in.
Drinks break.

OUT! Impact is umpire's call and the decision stands! India are starting to claw their way back in this game now. Shami continues from around the wicket and angles it in from outside off. Gets some heavy movement and catches Dawid Malan on the pads. Big shout and the finger goes up. The southpaw though, after speaking with his partner, decides to take it upstairs. Replays roll in and they show that the ball is just clipping the bails. So Malan is gone. Shami has been good with the ball in this session. Good bowling from him.
Review taken! This time by England. Dawid Malan has been caught leg before and given out. Looks to be gone. Height might be the only thing that saves him. Over to the TV umpire now...
Fuller from Shami, it's driven to mid off.
Good length delivery outside the line of off stump, Malan lets it be.
Fuller ball on middle, hit to mid on.
Joe plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Played to the mid-wicket region by Root.

FOUR! Edge and it races away to the fence. 6000 Test runs for Joe Root. Whaaatttaaa plaayyaaa! Not the best way he would have liked to get it but will take it nonetheless. Root rocks back and looks to cut this ball, gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies past Rahane at first slip to the fence.

NOT OUT! Malan comes down the track and that's what saves him. Impact over 3 meters. Ashwin gives this air around off, Malan charges to the ball and looks to play it to the leg side. Cannot get to the pitch of the ball and it goes to the third man fence off his boot. The players appeal but the umpire doesn't show any interest. Kohli takes the review. Time for the replays and it shows us Dawid was more than 3 meters down the track which puts the argument to bed.
Now then! India take a LBW review. Looks out, let's check.
Ravichandran Ashwin to roll his arm.
Back of a length ball on that fifth stump channel, Root goes to poke at it but leaves it at the last moment.
Punched off the back foot by Root to the man at point.
Played to the point region by Malan. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Poor ball and Malan gets his first boundary. Short and down leg, no real bounce on it showing the nature of the pitch. Dawid pulls this fine through fine leg to the fence.
Overpitched ball on middle and leg, flicked to short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, a superb drive but straight to the man at covers.
Soft edge but safe. Root tries playing the ball to the leg side but gets a soft edge to the off side. No damage done. Stays on 39.
The ball is doing a lot through the air. Root gets behind this one and sees it off.
Full on the pads, worked for the mid-wicket fielder to collect.
JR shoulders arms to let that one through.
Plays this with soft hands outside off, Malan cuts it towards gully to rotate strike.
Good movement from Sharma through the air. Lands this full in line of the stumps, Root drives it along the surface down the ground for a run. Gets one run closer to 6000 runs.
Ishant Sharma is back into the attack.
Good delivery. Forces Shami to play at it and almost gets the outside edge. Around off, it moves away from Dawid who plays and misses.
Serves this down leg, Malan keeps his bat near the pad but misses his shot.
Stays in his crease and blocks it in front of him.
Fuller one on leg, played to mid-wicket.
And Malan is off the mark straightaway. Cuts this ball from outside off through point for a brace.
Dawid Malan is the new man in.

OUT! How unlucky, but he was not at his best post lunch and just towards the end of the first session. He had few inside edges which went past his pole but not this one. A mix of both bad luck and streaky strokes. Perhaps, this is what India needed. Shami comes and delivers on his very first ball. This is a back of a length ball on middle and off. Jennings tries to block it down but gets a faint inside edge on it. The ball goes through his legs, spins and goes on to do just enough for the bails to fall. Jennings looks back in disappointment but there is nothing he can do about it now. India celebrate.
Mohammed Shami is called back into the attack as the batsmen try moving a pigeon, who does not want to move near short leg.
Better from Umesh. Lands it on the right length around off, the ball comes back in and hits Root on his back leg.
Outside off, left alone.
Getting fidgety there. This ball is outside off, Root goes for the cut but cannot make any contact.
Serves this down leg, Joe tries flicking it but makes contact with thin air.
Yadav bowls this on middle and leg, Root looks to tuck it away but gets beaten by pace. The ball hits him on his thigh pad.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Lands it on a good length outside off, it swings and moves away but Keaton shoulders his arms to it.
Not making Jennings play at these. Another fuller ball outside off, Keaton points his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Slower length ball outside off, Jennings watches the ball go past him.
Cuts this towards third man and jogs to complete the run.
Length ball outside off, it comes back in, Root shoulders his arms to it.
Fullish ball outside off, Root leans forward and carves it towards deep backward point for a brace as he reaches near his milestone of 6000 Test runs.
Ends the over by doing the same thing. This ball is full and outside off, easy leave for Keaton.
Similar ball, Jennings is happy to leave it alone.
Full and wide, left alone.
French cut misses the stumps. Fuller ball around off, Jennings gets an inside edge past the off stump trying to drive it. The ball runs to the vacant fine leg region where they get an easy two.
Short this time outside off, Root rocks back and cuts it towards backward point for one.
Umesh is pitching it up for swing and is getting it. Serves this full on middle and off, the ball moves in the air but Root defends it well.
Good running. Plays this with soft hands towards point and quickly hares to reach the other end. The crowd appreciates it.
Gets behind the ball and blocks it with a straight bat.
This ball is too far for Root to make contact.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
This one keeps straight. Pitches outside off and goes straight. Root pokes at it and the ball almost gets his outside edge.
Full and on off, played to the leg side.
Full on middle and off, Keaton hits it straight back to the bowler.
Outside off, Jennings shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Root cuts it past the backward point fielder for a run.
Works this one through square leg for one run.
Good from Umesh, who is getting the ball to come in. Bowls another one full on that fifth stump channel, Jennings looks to drive it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Runs in from over the wicket and lands it outside off, the ball comes in sharply and goes to Karthik behind the stumps.
Short and wide outside off, Root reaches for it and tries to cut it but cannot make contact.
Rocks back and punches the ball to the off side.
Opens the bat face and cuts it to backward point. One run added to the total.
Tries to angle this into Jennings but he shoulders his arms to it.
Hurls it in from over the wicket and serves it on middle and leg, Root flicks it to the leg side to get to the the end.
Back of a length ball around off, Root defends it off his back foot.
Ishant Sharma will bowl from the other end.
Covers his stumps and blocks this onto the ground.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.

FOUR BYES! Oh dear! That went horribly wrong. Lands this on a length way outside off, Jennings doesn't offer any shot to it and leaves it alone. Karthik dives to his left but cannot collect it. The ball runs to the third man fence. Boundary.
Pitches it up on off, Jennings drives it for the cover fielder to pick up.
Full again on middle and leg, played to the mid-wicket region.
Comes in from round the wicket and lands it full outside off, the ball nips back in but Keaton doesn't offer any shot to it.

We are back for the afternoon session. India have not made the most use of the morning session. Will now have to think out of the box to get these Englishmen out on a good batting track. Virat Kohli has some last few wise words in the team huddle. Keaton Jennings will take strike while Umesh Yadav will bowl the first over after lunch.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

A good session for England. 83 runs gathered for the loss of just one wicket. Would have been a touch worse had Ajinkya Rahane held on to the catch which would have dismissed Keaton Jennings. The day started off well for India with Ishant Sharma making use of the conditions on offer and then Ravichandran Ashwin coming on early (As Umesh Yadav was leaking runs) and sending Alastair Cook back to the pavilion. But since then, it's been England all the way as Jennings combined with skipper Joe Root to put the hosts in a good position come the break. The surface is just going to get better and better for batting, so the Indian bowlers will have to get innovative and fast. Join us for the second session at 1340 local (1240 GMT).
Almost did this time. Close. Length ball on middle and off, Root gets an inside edge which falls beside the leg stump after going off his pads. That's LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Full and attacking the base of off stump, nothing's going past Root it seems as he's solid in defense.
A back foot punch from Jennings square of the wicket on the off side earns him a single.

Was there an edge? Hardik Pandya seems confident of it, only issue is the umpire doesn't seem so. Fuller in length outside off, Jennings looks to flick and there's some noise as the ball goes past the batsman. Nothing from the umpire, replays confirm why too. The ball brushed off the thigh pad.
Fuller in length, angling across, blocked by staying perfectly behind the line.
Full and down the leg side, Jennings looks to flick it down fine but fails to connect.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Hurls it on a length, close to off, Joe with a good leave.
Cuts this late down to third man and rotates strike.
Too far outside off, no shot offered by the opener.

Short of a good length outside off, Jennings looks to steer it square on the off side off the back foot, but gets an inside edge back onto his pads. Could have just as easily dragged it back onto the stumps. Lucky.
'Round the wicket to Keaton Jennings. Length ball on off, zipping in, solidly blocked in front of cover.
Too far outside off, Root with a comfortable leave.
Just ahead of a length, on the off stick, Root defensively pushes it to the cover area.
Through point again, just a single this time.
FOUR! Very well played. Full and fired outside off, Jennings drives this uppishly through the vacant point region. Nobody out there in the deep as well, so it will race away to the boundary line.
Short of a good length outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Starts off with a good length ball on off stump, it's defended to covers.
Hardik Pandya brought on to bowl for the first time today.
Angling in at first before straightening up off the surface, Root stays right behind the line and presents a defensive bat in response.
Well left. Length delivery on the fourth stump line, moves away off the deck, Root watches it well and makes a good leave.
Fuller in length wide outside off, Root leans into the drive and connects well, but unfortunately finds the fielder at extra cover.
Around the wicket to Jennings, it's on the pads. The southpaw flicks it to fine leg and changes ends. With that, the 50-run stand comes up between the two.
Wide outside off, comfortably steered behind point. Third man comes running in as the batsmen take one.
Back of a length delivery, on middle and off, Root is back as he pushes it back out.

That was close! Could have just as easily been gone. Back of a length cutting back in on off, Root hangs his bat out to block but gets an inside edge which goes agonizingly close past the leg stump. Down to fine leg and a run is collected.
Shortish, outside off, Root goes for the pull but mistimes it to the man positioned at mid on.
Angling in on a back of a length on off, worked in front of square leg. Root calls for it and a quick single is stolen.
Pounded in short again, down the leg side this time, the batsman has nothing to do with it.
Switches the angle and comes around the wicket to the left-hander, bangs it in short. Keaton keeps his eyes on the ball and ducks.
Width offered outside off, cut down to third man. One run to the total.
Just short. Short of a length outside off, Jennings hangs his bat out and edges it just short of the diving gully fielder.
Another single down to third man. Root runs it to Shami placed there and jogs to the other end.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Opens the face of the bat after staying back and dabs it away through point. Single to the total.
Angling in at first, then straightening up just a shade on off, Root opens the face slightly and guides it towards third man for one run.
Seaming away off the deck, around off, Root covers the line and leaves it alone.
Full and swinging away outside off, Root leans into the shot and drives it just wide of extra cover for a single.
Switches the angle to over the wicket, keeps it a touch short on middle and off, it's worked just wide of mid-wicket for a brisk run.
Back of a length on off, the southpaw stands his ground and offers a firm punch back to the bowler.
That's close! That's straightened up just enough and almost done the damage. Full from Shami, angling in at first before changing direction, Jennings drives loosely and gets beaten.
Bumper, on middle this time, ducked and avoided yet again.
Bangs it in short, around off, Jennings ducks early and evades.
Worked off the pads and hit straight to short mid-wicket.
On a length and outside off, Joe doesn't bother himself with that.
FOUR! Too much room offered and Root's put it away. Lovely footwork to adjust. Gets himself on the back foot early and cracks the cut through point, beating third man to the fence.
One more leave from the England skipper. Leans across, it's well outside off, so he lets it be.
Shaping away from a good length, outside off, Root covers the line and shoulders arms.
Full and angling in on middle and off, Root drives it back down towards mid on.
Umesh Yadav is back on.
Speared full and wide, outside off, another leave. End of the over.
Comfortably outside off, despite it angling back in, Keaton Jennings with the easiest of leaves.
Fullish in length, coming back in on off, driven back down in the bowler's direction.
Angling back in as Shami continues from around the wicket, Jennings closes the bat face as he works it down on the leg side.
FOUR! Shot. A little bit of width and it's put away well by Jennings. Outside off, it's fiercely cut away square through point for a rocketing boundary.
Outside off on a back of a length, Keaton makes a safe leave.
Full from Ashwin, Root plants his front foot forward and blocks.
Stays well inside the crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Works with the spin and turns it away on the leg side.
Fuller in length on the stumps, blocked out.
Shorter and flatter outside off, Root goes back and defends it out.
Length on the fourth stump line, Jennings is solid in his defense.
Full again in line of the stumps, Jennings hits it back to the bowler.
This one keeps low. Outside off on a fuller length, the ball goes under the bat of Jennings who looks to drive it.
Stays back and cuts this ball wide of the point fielder for an easy run.
Short of a length ball around off, Root looks to punch it through but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length ball around off, Root leaves it alone.
Cut away, beautifully done from Root. Waits for it and cuts it late towards the third man region for three runs.
Flicks this from the crease towards mid-wicket for a run.
Stays back and plays it to the off side.
Root has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flicks this ball through the on side for a single.
Sharp turn again. Lands this on middle, is spins away from Jennings who shoulders his arms.
FOUR! All about the timing on that. Elegant stuff from the English Test skipper. Length delivery outside off, Root opens the face of the bat and runs it past short third man for a boundary.
Goes too full again, with a hint of inward swing. Root drives it to mid on but can't get it past the fielder. Should be careful though, next time Root might just find the boundary.
Possibly the attempted yorker, but it just misses. Still full enough to force Joe to dig it out back down the track.
Nice and full from Shami, on off stump, Root is rock solid in defense as he pushes it towards mid off.
Easy two for Joe. Works this off this hips and places it through backward square leg. Fine leg comes across to his left and cuts it off.
Short of a length outside off, Keaton hops and taps it to covers for a quick one.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Quicker, shorter and flatter on the stumps, Root goes deep inside the crease and blocks it out.
Leans forward and across before sweeping it down to fine leg for a single.
Drifting in on a fuller length on middle and off, driven but straight to the man at mid off.
The straighter one outside off, Jennings doesn't get drawn into it and smartly leaves it alone.
Full and straight, kept out with a straight bat.

Drinks are on the field. An even hour, but one which should have belonged to India. Ishant started off well and made good use of the new ball, should have had Jennings too had it not been for Rahane's dropped catch. Umesh leaked runs which forced the introduction of Ashwin early this morning. It reaped dividends as he got rid of Cook. Should be another good hour.
Hangs on the back foot and keeps it out to end the over.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Fired right up there, close to off, a defensive blade is presented in response.
Cutting back in on middle and leg, kept out off the back foot on the leg side beside the pitch.

Oh wow! First time it's been taken away from the right-hander and it's almost got the job done. Virat Kohli will want more of that. Length delivery in the corridor of uncertainty, Root has to play at it and almost nicks it behind.
Just behind a length on off, kept out off the back foot.
Mohammed Shami on to bowl.
Takes the southpaw by surprise. Sharp bounce off the surface outside off, Keaton Jennings rises and just about manages to keep it out and down on the off side.
Drifting in at first before turning away on middle, full in length. Jennings gets perfectly behind the line and blocks it out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pushes this quicker through the air, on middle and off, pushed off the inner half towards mid on.
Flights it up well outside off, bounces a bit off the deck, Jennings goes back and places it to point.
Some air on this, on middle, swept behind square on the leg side.
Fuller in length on the fifth stump line, the line is covered well as Joe lets it past him.
Shortens the length a touch on this occasion, cuts it back in on off, Root stays back and defends it in front of short mid-wicket.
Better. That's home, Ishant. Stay right there. Coming in from a length on off, Root meets it with a straight blade in defense.
Too wide of off stump, arms are shouldered.
FOUR! Loose ball again. Too much swing, coming in on the pads, no problem from skipper Joe Root to flick it fine. Beats fine leg and gets it across the boundary line.
Fuller in length, swinging back in on off, Root gets right behind the line and blocks it back down the track.
Spinning in, it goes off the inner edge behind square on the leg side for a run.
Straighter one outside off, it's run down to short third man off the back foot.
Takes the pace off it this time, loopy and full on off, Root presses forward and keeps it out.
Slightly quicker through the air again, on the stumps, Joe is back as he works it down in front of short leg.
Landed a touch short, it allows Keaton to go on the back foot and work it in front of square leg for one.
Full and outside off, quicker through the air, Jennings drives it square through point and gets a couple of runs for doing so. Hardik Pandya chases it down.
FOUR! Too straight in line and it's put away! Shorter on the hips, Root tickles it fine down the leg side for an easy boundary.
Pushes this into the vacant cover area and a quick single is taken.

Ishant should probably consider coming around the wicket to the left-hander. Over the wicket, he's sticking to that leg stump line. If he doesn't get the prodigious swing, the batsman see it. If it's too full, it's easy enough to play it out. Switching the angle might provide something different.
Speared full, just outside off, no swing on this occasion as Jennings misses his flick. It brushes the pads and Karthik behind the stumps makes a good save.
Wide outside off, left alone by the batsman.
FOUR! Edged and away! Not a bad delivery at all, Ishant serves it on a length on off. It goes away late and squares Jennings up. Off the edge and it races away down to the third man fence.
Good length delivery on off, cutting away off the deck, Jennings covers the line and lets it be.
Root is off the mark with a neat drive through the gap in the covers for two. A successful over from Ashwin comes to an end.
The skipper Joe Root walks into the middle next.

OUT! Bold move indeed! What an absolute beauty from Ravi Ashwin! Superb. Superb. It's the big wicket of Alastair Cook too. The offie comes from around the wicket and provides a lot of revs as he tosses it up on middle. Cook covers the line, thinking it will spin slightly. Doesn't account for the massive turn and gets undone by it. The ball goes past the outside edge and knocks the bails over. First strike for India.
Cook leans nicely into the shot and drives it to extra cover.
Fuller and close to off, blocked.
Slightest of turns as it's pitched around off, it takes the edge as Cook prods forward and goes well past the slip fielder.
Drifting in with some pace on this one, a bit short too. Jennings goes back and works it around the corner for one.
Shaping away from the surface, no trouble for Alastair Cook to let it be.
Too straight, on the pads, easily clipped down to fine leg. One run collected.
Maybe Ishant should try bringing one or two back in. It's allowing the two left-handers to get comfortable, given it's the same type of deliveries. Outside off, DK takes it behind the stumps.
Off the outer half but it falls safely. Length ball in the off stump channel, Jennings plays it towards point.
Touch further away outside off, no shot offered. Needs to bring it in closer, left alone.
Shaping away from around off, on a good length, tapped down in front of point for nothing.
Drifting in around off, on a fuller length, Cook guards it out safely.

Leg bye signalled, but it's actually gone off the glove. Flights it up on off, Jennings is down to sweep as it goes off the gloves behind square on the off side. Seems the umpire misses it. One leg bye taken.
Nice from Ashwin. Great shape on this as he floats it up on middle and off, Jennings presses forward and defends it off the inner half past the diving short leg fielder.
Full and attacking the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
Tossed up, with a lot of air on it, around off, driven along the ground to deep point for a single.
Looped up from around the wicket, Cook is well forward in defense.
Spin early on. Bold or just too impatient? Ravichandran Ashwin is into the attack after just six overs. A slip and a short leg have been provided to him.

The tall pacer is just a bit unfortunate this morning. He's been terrific here. Yorker fired in on middle stump, Cook barely manages to dig it out off the inner edge down towards fine leg. Single taken to end the over.
Chooses to leave the ball outside the off stump.
Plays this away square towards point and changes ends.

Did that not carry? It did. Oh dear. That's a dropped chance. Ishant once again with another superb delivery. Lands it on middle and it shapes away heavily. Jennings is squared up as he hangs his bat out in front of his pads, gets a thick edge and it flies towards the slip cordon. Rahane at fourth slip dives to his right, when he should have left it, and drops it. Had he not moved, it would have been a simple catch for Virat Kohli at third slip.
Could have been a wide. Almost. Ishant fires it well outside off, it's just inside the tramline as Keaton shoulders arms.
Full with some swing in the air well outside off, Keaton Jennings has nothing to do with it.
Much, much better. That's where he needs to be more often. In the channel outside off, Jennings gets beaten as he prods forward to defend.
FOUR! He will put them away all day long! Umesh really needs to get his radar more accurate. Fires it on the pads, Cook flicks it neatly through the mid-wicket region and that will be a boundary.
Comfortably done. Jennings plants his front foot forward, leans into the shot and pushes it well through the covers. Picks up a single for doing so.
Fullish in length attacking the stumps, firmly blocked in front of short mid-wicket.
Stays on the back foot again. Punches it through the same region but manages a single this time around.
FOUR! A tad short and Alastair Cook has put it away. Around off, not much venom on it, so the southpaw rises on his toes and cracks it through cover-point to find the fence.
Look who's showed up! Monty Panesar is seen in the stands.
Jennings watches the ball closely, it's wide outside off, so he leaves it alone.
Fuller on the stumps, worked wide of mid on for a single.
Again some good movement off the seam. Length ball around off, Cook shapes up for the shot as he opens the face and dabs it in front of point.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, Cook defends it off the outer half towards mid off. No harm done.
Well outside off on this occasions, Cook mind's his own business and lets it go.

Wowza! Ishant's on fire this morning. Just the second over, yes, but he's making the ball talk. Pitches it on middle and makes it swing away, Cook has no option but to play at it. It whiskers past the edge and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
Brings it in closer this time, forces Jennings forward to block it out on the off side.
Served on a length, outside the line of off stump, no shot offered in response.
Needs to get his line checked, Umesh. He's bowling too straight which is allowing Keaton Jennings to put it away on the leg side. This time it's played through backward square leg for two more.
Played with soft hands. That's the trick that saved him. Just ahead of a length close to off, Jennings comes half-forward as he edges it on the bounce to the diving third slip fielder.
Nicely done. Fuller delivery fraction straight in line, flicked through the gap in the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs.
FOUR! First boundary of the day for England! Fuller and coming in on the pads, Jennings just clips it off his pads down across the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Another easy leave. Cook shoulders arms to let Dinesh Karthik collect it with ease. Testing over from Ishant comes to a close.
Further away outside off, easy enough this time for the former England Test skipper to leave it alone.

Oh deary me! This is a superb first over from Ishant so far. On middle and off, deviating off the surface away from Alastair Cook. He can only hang his bat out and hope he doesn't nick it behind. Fortunately for him, he doesn't. Just gets beaten.
Beaten! What a ripper from Ishant Sharma! Good length delivery on off, moving away just a shade with some extra bounce, Cook is once again squared up a bit and beaten past the outside edge.
Going across the left-hander on a length, outside off, it's left alone for the keeper to collect.

Sharp movement off the deck! Ishant lands it on leg and it moves heavily towards off, Cook is squared up as he tries to defend this. It goes past the edge and off the back thigh pad towards the slip cordon.
Ishant Sharma to share the new ball. He has three slips in place as well, along with a gully.
Hurled away well outside off, going across, Jennings lets it be to end the first over.
On the fuller side of the length, in line of the stumps, driven to mid on tamely.
Fires it full and swings it back in on off, Jennings leans forward and meets it with the full face of the bat.
Cook and England are off the mark. He pushes this full delivery outside off to the covers and gets to the other end.
Ooooffff! Talk about close shaves! On a good length and seaming back in, with some extra bounce, Cook dangerously shoulders arms to it as the ball goes over the stumps.
Superb delivery first up! Lands it on a back of a length around off and it jags back in sharply, Cook is forced to go back and defend it down on the track.

Well... Finally! We're ready to rock and roll. Alastair Cook and Keaton Jennings stride out to the middle amidst a big English cheer. The Indian players spread out across the field. Umesh Yadav has the new cherry in hand first up. Three slips and a gully in place. Wait! A fielding change before the first ball is even bowled. Gully comes out to a catch short mid-wicket position. Interesting. Anyway, here we go...

Adil Rashid giving an interview on the sidelines says that this series is a good challenge and he is looking forward to it. On making a comeback, he says he would have never imagined playing Test cricket so early. He adds saying that the mindset is very important and wants to have the same mentality set as he does for white-ball cricket. He suggests that it is important to stick to his positives. Continues saying that his role in the team is to create chances and says that he is not under pressure. Ends by saying that he will give it his all.

Virat Kohli says they were thinking of bowling first. Reckons it's going to be a good batting surface as Joe Root mentioned. Wants to exploit the conditions early on. Is really looking forward to do well and the guys are well prepared and excited to get things going. Feels the pitch looks very different compared to last year and it's going to be a good contest between the two teams. Adds that they don't carry any excess baggage despite not having a good record here. Let's everyone know they are going with three seamers, with Hardik Pandya as the all-rounder and Ravichandran Ashwin as the off spinner. Lands a big surprise by saying KL Rahul is in the team and Cheteshwar Pujara misses out.

Joe Root says it looks a good surface with a little bit cloud cover, but should be a good day for batting. Mentions they have been practicing well and it's all about delivering now. States that it's a great opportunity for his players to prove a point. Informs that the team has been picked after examining the pitch and is confident this bunch can get the job done.
TOSS - The spin of the coin goes Joe Root's way. And as mentioned a little bit earlier by Manjrekar, ENGLAND OPT TO BAT FIRST!

Pitch Report - Sanjay Manjrekar glancing over out there in the middle says there is some moisture in the pitch to begin with. Adds that overall, there isn't any fresh grass, but enough to assist the seamers early on. Continues saying the team winning the toss should bat first, as the surface will wear a different colour as the game goes on. He mentions that going with two spinners shouldn't be a problem at all and if Virat Kohli wins the toss, he has a big decision to make whether he wants to protect that apparent frail batting line-up.

If you've got a day off, pop that corn, kick back on those recliners and witness the spectacle about to be put on display. And if you're at work unfortunately, then pull up those smartphones and tune in on here to catch all the action. It's finally here, welcome to the big stage, ladies and gents. England and India lock horns in the much-awaited Test series. Plenty surrounding this red-ball contest. Who's going to play? Who'll miss out? England have already announced their XI, remains to be seen what combination India field. You can bet it's going to be a thrilling contest, with mind games and some (healthy) banter taking place throughout. Keep your eyes stuck here, the all-important pitch report and toss aren't far away...
